claims.text: Sandyman owned and ran the Old Mill in Hobbiton around and well before. The Gaffer was not very fond of Sandyman, or his habits of telling tall tales and having quick judgment of others.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, The Return of the King, "The Scouring of the Shire"

claims.text: Prior to Bilbo's Farewell Party, while gossiping about Frodo Baggins and the death of his parents, Sandyman related the rumour that his mother had pushed his father from a boat and he pulled her down; and was scolded by Gaffer for believing such rumours. He wondered about Bilbo augmenting his wealth by going out for journeys, and Gandalf and Dwarves visiting him.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, The Fellowship of the Ring, "A Long-expected Party"
